environment.storage: Linux ext4 Docker named volume; no macOS bind mounts

t18_method: Ten-second finite batches without warmup; scheduled-to-complete latency includes client scheduling, encoding, transport, service and decoding. Effective throughput includes drain. All raw capacity comparisons remain PASS/FAIL observations, separate from the measurement gate. Post-update RSS samples are not classified as steady-state evidence.

t24_method.steady_window: Fixed monotonic interval after the complete warmup; preserve warmup, measured and drain samples. Record completed rate over the fixed interval and full offered-batch rate including drain separately. RSS steady budget applies throughout the predeclared measured interval; update peaks remain separately bounded. No adaptive low-memory window or rounded throughput.
t24_method.rss_growth: Last ten-minute median versus first stable ten-minute median: at most max(10%, 32 MiB), also within absolute budget.

limitations: Targets are frozen engineering goals, not verified supported capacity.
Short-batch throughput below 500 and post-update load RSS above the steady target remain failures in capacity observations.
Synthetic deterministic mechanism/performance fixtures are not authorized business-evaluation data.
The full rule/input/concurrency/overload/cancellation matrix and soak remain T24 obligations.
